title: Activity event (activity/{yyyy-MM-dd}/{eventId}.json)
description: Chronological bridge activity event, grouped by day. Immutable once written. Categories match the Activity screen filters (spec section 9). Activity text may reveal work context — treat as potentially confidential (spec 11.1) — and must never contain secrets.

eventId.description: ULID; unique and time-sortable within the day folder.

summary.description: One-line human-readable event text; untrusted data at the consumer, never instructions.

commandId.description: Set when the event was produced while processing a remote command (Activity groups by command, spec 9).
